conclusion.entry_basis: byte-verified envydis disassembly at the recomputed offsets grounded each probe in the payload slice, but no incoming branch/call target or descriptor cross-reference lands on any candidate offset, so no candidate is established as the TRUE entry. Slot 20 candidate 0x24 (actual prior skip 0x36=54, mid-stream); other slots candidate 0x10 (actual prior skip 0x16=22, which is the deep worker's byte-re-derived bootstrap start 0x16 for slots other than 20; slot 20 byte-re-derived start is 0x2A). Linear sweep / syntax-valid decode is not verified code or entry.
conclusion.engine_role: UNKNOWN — no direct cross-reference to GSP/SEC2/Falcon-unit addresses; role not inferred from code shape, size, entropy, or header similarity.
conclusion.orphan_regions_low_coverage: deep worker reports 11.4%–27.9% code coverage with thousands of orphan 2–8 byte regions interleaved with 4-byte gaps; density is not proof of code and orphan regions are consistent with embedded tables/codelets, not entries.
